programs.title: Wild \u0026 Weird America
programs.desc: The creators of the program present a collection of shocking recordings.Viewers can see car accidents and massive avalanches, and even a terrifying glider flight.

programs.title: Feds

programs.desc: Often spectacular chases will be presented, captured on police cameras.Criminals will do anything to escape law enforcement.

programs.title: Tunnelbanan 8
programs.desc: Security guards and staff ensure the safety and smooth operation of the Stockholm Metro.They catch thieves and help passengers in trouble.

programs.title: Megatransporty
programs.desc: The MTD team, led by Makuwa and Mirek, transporting the reactor to Belarus will have to deal with a sharp left turn and obstacles such as a house standing very close to the road, high curbs and a high-voltage pole.The Transdor team transporting the boat to the Bieszczady Mountains will have to be careful not to damage the load on the branches of roadside trees at the end of the route.Later it will unload at Solina.After making a wrong exit from the roundabout, JCS heading to the power plant in Kozienice will try to make up for lost time.However, the last section of the route will consist of local roads that will not allow for driving too fast.

programs.title: Jeremy Wade: Dark Waters
programs.sub_title: The beast from the Jurassic river
programs.desc: Angler and adventurer Jeremy Wade goes to Alaska to check what happened to the black salmon - a fish representing the strongest species of salmonids, known in the USA as "king salmon".

programs.title: Extreme Loggers
programs.desc: An interesting series of meetings with people performing one of the most dangerous professions in the world - lumberjacks.To pursue this profession, you must demonstrate certain character traits.You have to be tough, strong and determined.According to statistics from the USA, there are 21 times more cases of death at work in this profession than in other occupations.In the program, we get to know both family businesses that have been cutting down trees for years, as well as huge corporations.We watch as masters of this profession face difficult challenges in the most hostile places on earth.
